text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘The Train Ride’ (रेल का सफ़र)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘The Train Ride’ (Rail ka safar). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘The Train Ride’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘train’ मतलब रेलगाड़ी। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘train’ matlab railgaadi. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘train’ means रेलगाड़ी. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘window’ मतलब खिड़की। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘window’ matlab khidki. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘window’ means खिड़की. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘station’ मतलब स्टेशन। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘station’ matlab station. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘station’ means स्टेशन. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: We go to Nani's house by train.
I see green fields and white cows.
The train stops at a big station.
I run to her and hug her tight.

question.en: Whose house do they go to?

question.hi: खिड़की से बच्चा क्या देखता है?
question.hinglish: Khidki se bachcha kya dekhta hai?
question.en: What does the child see from the window?
